fulfillingLocationId.description: ID of the specific fulfilment centre that will fulfil this order. Populated by BPP at on_confirm after internal FC selection. Present when provider has multiple FC locations.
fulfillingLocationId.x-ion-condition: Present when provider has multiple fulfilment centres

invoicePreferences.description: Buyer's invoice type and tax identity declaration.

scheme.description: NPWP for businesses, NIK for individuals

invoiceType.description: RECEIPT: simple receipt, no tax identity required. TAX_INVOICE: Faktur Pajak, requires PKP seller and NPWP buyer. EINVOICE: e-Faktur via DJP system. SURAT_TAGIHAN: PKP seller to non-PKP buyer — commercial invoice, no input-tax claim rights. KOMERSIAL_INVOICE: cross-border commercial invoice, bilingual layout.

fakturPajakReference.description: Faktur Pajak (e-Invoice) reference number assigned by BPP after contract confirm for PKP sellers. 16-digit DJP format.
fakturPajakReference.x-ion-condition: Required for PKP sellers (identity.pkpStatus=PKP) when invoiceType=TAX_INVOICE

purchaseOrderReference.description: Buyer's Purchase Order number for B2B wholesale transactions. Allows buyer to link ION contract to their internal PO system.
purchaseOrderReference.x-ion-condition: Required for B2B wholesale commerce patterns

cancellationReasonCode.description: Standardised cancellation reason code when contract is cancelled. Set by BPP on contract at time of cancellation.
cancellationReasonCode.x-ion-condition: Required when contract status is CANCELLED

quoteTrail.description: Trail of quote changes for mid-transaction-changes variant. Each entry records a delta to the original confirmed quote.

id.description: Item ID or consideration ID this adjustment applies to

value.description: Signed IDR amount. Negative for deductions, positive for additions.

partialCancellationAllowed.description: Whether individual items in a multi-item order can be cancelled.

replacementPreferred.description: Whether buyer prefers replacement over refund in case of defective or wrong item. Declared at confirm.

disputeWindowDays.description: Number of days after delivery within which buyer may raise a dispute. Defaults to ION network policy if not declared.

creditTermsDays.description: Number of days credit extended to the buyer from delivery date. 0 = prepaid. Common values: 7, 14, 30, 45, 60, 90.
creditTermsDays.x-ion-condition: Required for business-procurement (business-credit variant) commerce pattern

paymentDueDate.description: Absolute datetime by which payment must be made for credit orders. Computed from delivery date + creditTermsDays.

subscriptionBillingCycle.description: Billing cycle for subscription commerce pattern.

subscriptionNextBillingDate.description: Date-time of next billing event. Updated by BPP after each successful billing.

linkedContractId.description: Reference to the Trade Contract this Logistics Contract serves. Enables ION Central to trace causal relationship between trade and logistics transactions.
linkedContractId.x-ion-condition: Required on all Logistics Contracts linked to a Trade fulfilment

codAmount.description: Total cash amount to be collected from consumer at delivery for COD orders. String decimal in IDR.

beaCukaiReference.description: Indonesian Customs (Bea Cukai) clearance reference number. Required for all international inbound shipments.
beaCukaiReference.x-ion-condition: Required for INTERNATIONAL_AIR and INTERNATIONAL_OCEAN logistics

liveCommerceContext.description: Context for orders placed via live commerce or social commerce (TikTok Shop, Shopee Live, Tokopedia Play, OTT-embedded commerce). Required for live-commerce pattern. Enables revenue attribution to streamer/affiliate and platform-specific settlement.

sourceChannel.description: Entry point for the order. OTT_EMBEDDED = order placed from within video streaming app (Netflix, Vidio, Disney+ Hotstar shoppable content).

streamerId.description: Creator/streamer subscriber ID for revenue attribution. Streamer may earn commission separately from BPP/BAP.

streamerCommissionPercent.description: Streamer's commission as fraction of item value

productPinnedAtMinute.description: Minutes into the live session when this product was pinned/featured

ottPlatform.description: OTT platform where shoppable content was served (for OTT_EMBEDDED)

ottContentId.description: OTT platform's content ID (movie, episode, match) where item was shown

ottTimestampSeconds.description: Playback position in seconds when product was presented

groupBuyMinParticipants.description: Minimum participants needed for group discount to activate

groupBuyActivated.description: Whether group-buy discount has been unlocked

liveCommerceContext.x-ion-condition: Required for live-commerce pattern; optional otherwise

refundDestination.description: Where refund will be credited. When buyer does not specify, default is ORIGINAL_PAYMENT_METHOD. Platform wallets often faster; store credit used for partial refunds and goodwill.

loyaltyMultiplier.description: Bonus multiplier when redeeming to loyalty points e.g. 1.1 = 10% bonus

subscriptionTrialDays.description: First N days free. Billing starts on day N+1.

subscriptionPauseType.description: Current pause state for subscription orders

subscriptionPauseUntil.description: Date to automatically resume. Required when pauseType=PAUSED_UNTIL_DATE

giftingDetails.description: Structured gifting details replacing the simple gift flag.

giftMessage.description: Message printed on gift card / packing slip

hideSenderInfo.description: Anonymous gift — omit buyer details from all visible surfaces

priceDisplayOnPackage.description: Whether to show prices on packing slip

giftWrapOfferId.description: Reference to the gift-wrap offer in consideration breakup

paymentSchedule.description: Multi-milestone payment schedule for partial-payment offers (down-payment + balance, milestone-based for services, etc.). Used when paymentTermsPolicy references a schedule-based IRI. Single-payment orders do not require this field. Contract moves to COMPLETE only when all milestones are PAID.

amount.description: IDR amount due at this milestone

dueAt.description: Absolute datetime when payment is due

paymentMethod.description: Method used for this specific milestone (may differ across milestones)

gatewayRef.description: Gateway transaction reference for this milestone

graceDays.description: Grace period before status becomes OVERDUE

gift.description: Simple gift flag. When true, populate giftingDetails for recipient name, message, and wrap preferences.
gift.x-ion-condition: Optional; when true, giftingDetails should be populated

cancellationReason.description: Structured cancellation reason with machine-readable code and localised description. Set by the requesting party at time of cancel.

id.description: Unique reason identifier. Matches an entry in offer.cancellationAllowedReasons.

shortDesc.description: Localised short reason for consumer display.

cancellationReason.x-ion-condition: Required on /cancel request and on_cancel callback

cancellationTags.description: Structured metadata bag for the cancellation event. Used in force-cancel (TAT breach) scenarios.

force.description: True when BAP is force-cancelling due to BPP TAT breach.

lastBppInteractionAt.description: Timestamp of last received BPP message — documents the TAT breach.

expectedStatusBy.description: Datetime by which BPP was expected to send on_status per declared SLA.

cancellationTags.x-ion-condition: Required when force-cancelling after BPP TAT breach

cancelledCommitmentIds.description: Line IDs from commitments[] that have been individually cancelled in a partial-cancellation flow.

subscriptionAction.description: Action being applied to a subscription in a lifecycle management /update call.
subscriptionAction.x-ion-condition: Required on /update calls for subscription lifecycle management

dunningReminderSequence.description: Sequence number of this dunning (payment reminder) attempt for overdue credit orders.
dunningReminderSequence.x-ion-condition: Required on /update when creditTermsDays > 0 and payment is overdue

legalEntityName.description: Registered legal entity name of the buyer organisation for B2B wholesale and business-procurement patterns.
legalEntityName.x-ion-condition: Required for B2B wholesale and business-procurement patterns

nib.description: Nomor Induk Berusaha (Business Registration Number) of the buyer organisation.
nib.x-ion-regulatory: PP 24/2018 tentang Pelayanan Perizinan Berusaha OSS
nib.x-ion-condition: Required for B2B wholesale and business-procurement patterns at confirm

npwp.description: NPWP (Nomor Pokok Wajib Pajak) of the buyer. Required when invoicePreferences.invoiceType=TAX_INVOICE.
npwp.x-ion-condition: Required when invoiceType=TAX_INVOICE or buyer is a PKP entity
